Read-only forensic investigation. Repo: /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa, branch feature/SFCC-55_global-footer-ui (compare against origin/develop). Do NOT modify any file. Do NOT run `npm start` or build Storybook. Use absolute paths.

I am auditing whether four known issues on this branch were raised and then DROPPED, and for how long they sat unresolved. For EACH, I need: (a) when it was first raised/introduced (git log dates, commit hashes, commit message text), (b) the CURRENT state in the working tree (is it fixed, partially fixed, or still broken?), (c) hard evidence (file path + line + code snippet).

=== ITEM 1: WCAG 2.5.8 target-size failure ===
The story SFCC-55 acceptance criteria name a "Stay in Touch" email input field and submit button. WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 (Target Size Minimum) requires interactive targets be at least 24x24 CSS px.
- Find the footer's subscribe submit control. Look in /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmInputAction/index.tsx and /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/theme/components/ (zimmTextInput.ts, footer.ts, zimmInputAction if it exists).
- Determine the actual rendered hit-target size of that submit control (look for width/height/minWidth/minHeight/padding/iconSize values, and resolve any token names against /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/theme/foundation/sizes.ts and spacing.ts).
- Also check the ZimmTextInput clear control and any other footer interactive controls (locale control, contact icons, nav items) for the same issue.
- Search the whole repo for any mention of "2.5.8", "target size", "target-size", "targetSize", "24x24", "24px" in comments/docs, plus `git log --all --grep` for the same. Did anyone raise it? When?
- Report: which controls are under 24x24, exact computed size, and whether ANY commit ever addressed it.

=== ITEM 2: Font licence prohibition reversal ===
Two commits appear to contradict each other:
- a81a927 "fix(footer): remove self-hosted Futura Round font files and FontStyles injector" (2026-08-17)
- 34486eb "feat(theme): self-host Futura Round for development and testing" (2026-08-20)
Get the FULL commit body of both (`git show --stat --format=full <hash>` / `git log -1 --format=%B <hash>`). Establish: what reason was given for removing the fonts (licence? legal?), and what reason was given for re-adding them 3 days later. Was the licence question ever actually resolved, or was the prohibition simply reversed? Search the repo and .docs/ for "licence", "license", "Futura", "font licence", "Monotype", "foundry", "EULA". Check /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/static/fonts/ for what is currently committed and whether the files are tracked in git. Check .gitignore. Also check whether .claude/rules/frozenFiles.md was edited to document the self-hosting (commit 34486eb touched it) and what it now says.

=== ITEM 3: Locale label wrong on 7 of 8 storefronts ===
Commit cc9a8f1 "fix(footer): correct the locale placeholder label for the served storefront" (2026-08-21).
- `git show cc9a8f1` in full.
- Read the CURRENT footer implementation's locale control: /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/footer/index.tsx.
- Determine whether the locale label is now correct for ALL storefronts or hardcoded/derived for only one. Cross-reference the real site list in /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/config/sites.js and config/default.js (l10n / locales) — how many sites/locales exist, and does the footer's label logic actually cover them?
- Check .docs/prd/regional.md for the expected per-storefront locale labels.
- Report: is this genuinely fixed for all 8 storefronts, or fixed for one and still wrong for the rest? Show the code.

=== ITEM 4: projectState.md silence ===
- Read /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/.docs/memory/projectState.md.
- Count mentions of: "SFCC-55", "footer", "Footer", "ui-kit", "ZimmFooter", "subscribe".
- `git log origin/develop..HEAD -- .docs/memory/` — was any memory file touched on this branch at all?
- `git log -1 --format='%h %ad %s' --date=short -- .docs/memory/projectState.md` on develop — when was it last updated, and what sprint/state does it claim the project is in?
- Also check .docs/memory/sprintScope.md for whether SFCC-55 / footer appears.
- Report the exact counts and last-updated date.

Return a tight, factual report organised by item, with dates, commit hashes, file paths and code snippets. Flag explicitly anywhere you could NOT establish a fact. Do not speculate — if evidence is absent, say "no evidence found".

- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Author: Marcel Angelo Navarro <marcel.a.n.navarro@accenture.com>

    feat(theme): self-host Futura Round for development and testing
    
    foundation/fonts.ts already lists 'Futura Round' first in both stacks, so the
    @font-face declaration is the only thing that makes it resolve — no component,

    because the css`` template is evaluated at module-init, so every URL would
    silently lose its bundle prefix and fall back to the system font.
    
    The fallback stack renders roughly 13% wider, which is why serving the real
    faces matters for design-parity review against Figma.

     2	
     3	// Figma Textfield flush variant (node 40000265:374): field/border/* tokens.
     4	// hover and filled (has value, unfocused) both darken to focus colour per Figma spec.

    17	  hover: 'var(--zimm-color-text-inverse)',

    31	// moved — at 200% zoom the slot reached 90px while the field reached only 53px, so the slot
    32	// over-reserved by ~37px. (Dead space, not clipping: the no-layout-shift guarantee held either
    33	// way, which is why this is a correctness-of-derivation fix rather than a bug fix.) In rem the
    34	// derivation holds at every zoom level: at 200%, 72 + 16 + 1 = 89px against a 90px slot, the 1px

Author: Marcel Angelo Navarro <marcel.a.n.navarro@accenture.com>

    feat(theme): self-host Futura Round for development and testing
    
    foundation/fonts.ts already lists 'Futura Round' first in both stacks, so the
    @font-face declaration is the only thing that makes it resolve — no component,
    recipe or token changes. Only two faces ship because only two are used: all 22
    textStyles resolve to fontWeight 400 or 500, and fonts.body === fonts.heading.
    
    fontFace.tsx resolves the bundle-prefixed asset root synchronously. It
    reimplements two lines of getAssetUrl rather than importing it: that helper
    pulls in ssr-config (cosmiconfig/fs), and importing it lazily cannot work
    because the css`` template is evaluated at module-init, so every URL would
    silently lose its bundle prefix and fall back to the system font.
    
    The fallback stack renders roughly 13% wider, which is why serving the real
    faces matters for design-parity review against Figma.
    
    Tier 1 files touched, approved by a tier-1-approver (GitHub identity verified):
      .storybook/main.js       — staticDirs mapping so fonts resolve in Storybook
      .storybook/preview.tsx   — mounts ZimmFontFace, mirroring _app-config
      .claude/rules/frozenFiles.md — records the self-hosted fonts
    
    Licence files are deliberately excluded from the repository.

33:ROW also routed via `/en-ch/` and `/en-ca/` prefixes (DMU-013; see [dataMigrationSeo.md](dataMigrationSeo.md) for full URL strategy). AU configured as root with no locale prefix and designated x-default hreflang target (DMU-016, **Resolved** — the AU root remains globally crawlable because search-engine and social-unfurler bots are exempt from the human geo-redirect; see REG-009 in Section 4).
51:- **HK (`/hk/`, Global-e):** Hong Kong (default), China, Macau, Taiwan, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, Philippines, India, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Brunei, Cambodia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Laos, Maldives, Mongolia, Myanmar, Nepal, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Tajikistan, Timor-Leste, Uzbekistan. **Also includes "Australia" as a destination** — this is the REG-027 path for non-Oceania clients who select AU in the country selector (they are routed to HK, not the gated AU site).
63:- **AU is gated** to AU and NZ/Pacific Island IPs only (REG-009). AU is the `x-default` hreflang and must remain crawlable, so it is never blocked at the network level. A non-AU/non-Oceania human visitor landing on AU is redirected server-side to their matched storefront before AUD pricing renders; if no storefront matches their region, fall back to HK. Search-engine and social-unfurler bots are exempt from the redirect — match by User-Agent against a comprehensive allowlist (Googlebot incl. Image/News, Bingbot, DuckDuckBot, AppleBot, YandexBot, Baiduspider, Slackbot, Twitterbot, facebookexternalhit, LinkedInBot, WhatsApp, Discordbot). Fail open: if UA looks botty but isn't matched, skip the redirect rather than apply it — false-positive cost is zero, missing a real crawler hurts SEO.
64:- All other storefronts use **mismatch detection** (REG-014): a country slide-out is shown on the first visit if the user's IP country does not match the storefront's shipping region (REG-015). Two CTAs: redirect to the appropriate storefront, or open the country selector (REG-016). A warning is shown that changing location may remove items from the bag (REG-017). Not shown if country matches (REG-018). Shown on first visit only — does not reappear after selection or dismissal (REG-019).
65:- **Country + language selector** available on all storefronts except AU (REG-020, REG-025). Countries grouped by region (Asia/Oceania, Europe, Americas) with currency display and search field (REG-021). Warning shown that changing location may remove items from the bag (REG-022). Country and language combined in the same selector; EU domestic offers EN/FR/IT/ES, all other storefronts English only (REG-023). Selected EU locale reflected in URL (REG-024).
67:- **China** selected from any country selector routes to HK (REG-026).
68:- **Australia** selected from another storefront's country selector (i.e. clients outside Oceania) routes to HK (REG-027).
69:- Global-e checkout locks the shipping country — determined by country selector pre-checkout, cannot be changed inside Global-e (REG-028).
112:- EU domestic supports 4 languages: EN, FR, IT, ES (REG-044). All other storefronts English only.
114:- English is the site-wide fallback where translated content is unavailable (REG-046).

_🎯 Functional Correctness_ | _🟡 Minor_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**The locale control is announced as actionable but performs no action.**

`onClick={undefined}` leaves a focusable `<button>` with `aria-label="Change locale"`. Keyboard and screen-reader users reach it, activate it, and nothing happens. The label text `'United States (USD) / ENG'` is also hardcoded, and it contradicts the fixture locale (`Global Footer — EN-AU`), so the rendered footer states the wrong locale.

Until the locale selector lands, set `disabled` (or `aria-disabled` plus `tabIndex={-1}`) so the control does not promise an ac

**Do not key layout behaviour off the English heading text.**

Lines 429, 447, and 474 compare `group.fields.heading` with `CONTACT_GROUP_HEADING` (`'Contact'`). The heading is localised Contentful content, and this footer ships to eight storefronts. For any locale whose heading is not exactly `'Contact'`, the contact indent is lost and `ContactIconRow` is not rendered at all, so the phone, WhatsApp, and email channels disappear.

Key off stable data instead, for example `group.sys.id`, or add an explicit boolean field such as `showCont
---

**Enable clearing in the `Filled` story.**

`localeButton` defines `_focusVisible` with an inverse outline at lines 461-465. `contactIconLink` defines none, so a focused contact anchor falls back to the browser default outline on the dark footer background. Contrast of that default is not guaranteed. Add the same inverse focus treatment for consistency.

content.text:
Investigation complete. I modified nothing; all findings are from git history, GitHub API, and reads.

**Caveat on the working tree:** other agents in this session are actively editing files (`git status` changed between my first and second tool call). All working-tree observations below are a snapshot at `HEAD = 9ec0740`. I did not run the app or Storybook, so sizes in Item 1 are **derived statically** from the theme chain, not measured in a browser.

---

# ITEM 1 — WCAG 2.5.8 target size: **no defect substantiated; one silent mis-citation fix**

## (a) Was it ever raised?

| Date | Ref | What |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-06-12 | `cd60b7a` | `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md:81` — "_(Bonus)_ Considered WCAG 2.2 AA additions (focus appearance, **target size 24×24**, dragging movements)". A checklist prompt, not a finding. |
| 2026-08-17 | `200c044` | `fix(ui-kit): improve ZimmTextInput clear button hit area…` — body: "Add 24px minWidth/minHeight to clear button for touch accessibility (**WCAG 2.5.5**)". **Wrong criterion**: 2.5.5 is Target Size (Enhanced), AAA/44px. The AA/24px criterion is 2.5.8. |
| 2026-08-20 | `3220239` | Citation silently corrected to `// WCAG 2.2 AA SC 2.5.8 — 24px minimum target size` when the clear-button style moved into the theme recipe. No commit-message mention of the correction. |
| 2026-08-20 | `e950e6e` | `footer.ts:405` — `// Contact icon touch target — 24px, matches Figma 24x24 (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8).` |

`git log --all --grep` for `target.size`, `2.5.8`, `24x24`, `tap target`: **no matches**. Searching all 44 review comments across PR #55 and PR #59 for `2.5.8|target.size|24x24|24×24|hit area|tap target`: **no matches**. **No evidence found that a target-size failure was ever raised by anyone.**

## (b)/(c) Current state — every footer interactive control

| Control | Derivation chain | Computed | 2.5.8 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Subscribe submit** (the AC-named control) | `footer/index.tsx:238-245` (no `size`/`style`) → `zimmInputAction/index.tsx:70-77` (no `size`) → `zimmButton/index.tsx:35,44-53` `ICON_SIZE_DEFAULT='md'`, `size="icon"` → `button.ts:227-231` `{h:'auto', minW:'auto', p:'xs'}` → `theme/index.ts:56` `space: spacing` → `spacing.ts:11` `xs:'0.5rem'` (8px); icon `zimmIcon/index.tsx:147` `boxSize=iconSizes.md` → `sizes.ts:10` `'16px'` | **32 × 32** (16 + 8 + 8) | Pass |
| ZimmTextInput clear ✕ | `zimmTextInput.ts:155-156` `minWidth/minHeight: 'var(--zimm-scale-xl)'` → `zimmTokens.ts:143` = `spacing.xl` = 1.5rem | **24 × 24** — and `clearable` defaults `false` (`zimmTextInput/index.tsx:65`), no consumer opts in, so **it does not render in the footer at all** | Pass (moot) |
| Contact icon links | `footer.ts:411-416` `width/height: 'var(--zimm-scale-xl)'` | **24 × 24** exactly | Pass (at the floor) |
| Site-map nav items | `zimmNavItem.ts:23,28-29` `minHeight: var(--zimm-scale-xl)`, `lineHeight: 0.875rem` (14px), `paddingBlock: 4.5px` → 23px floored to 24px; width `SIZE_COL_NAV` = 140px | **24 × ≤140** | Pass (at the floor) |
| Legal links (bottom bar) | same, plus `footer.ts:442` `paddingY:'xs'` (8px) → 14+16 | **30 × auto** | Pass |
| Locale control | `footer.ts:517-538` — `localeButton` padding 0, `localeText` `paddingY:'xs'`, `textStyle:'footer'` (10px/14px line) → 14+16 | **~30 × wide** | Pass |
| Wordmark button | `footer.ts:350-355` reset, padding 0; `zimmLogo.ts:9-10,19` `327px × 39px` | **≤327 × 39** | Pass |
| Modal Cancel/Continue | `footer/index.tsx:153-154` `size="medium"` → `button.ts:206` `BTN_HEIGHT_SM='41px'` | **41px tall** | Pass |

**Verdict:** no control derives below 24 × 24 CSS px. The premise of a 2.5.8 failure is **not supported by the code**. The real (minor) finding is the 2026-08-17 → 2026-08-20 **mis-citation of SC 2.5.5 for a 2.5.8 requirement**, corrected without acknowledgement. Two controls sit exactly at the 24px floor (contact icons, nav items) — compliant, but with zero margin.

---

# ITEM 2 — Font licence prohibition: **reversed, never resolved**

## (a) Full timeline of the font binaries

| Date | Commit | Action |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-08-12 | `6c608b1` | 10 `.woff2` faces added to `overrides/app/static/fonts/` |
| 2026-08-17 | `8c25f11` | 2 faces present on this branch (Regular, Medium) |
| **2026-08-17** | **`a81a927`** (author Jersey Perez, committer Marcel Navarro) | **Removed.** Body verbatim: *"Monotype Desktop licence forbids server distribution of the .woff2 files. Font delivery **deferred until Zimmermann obtains the Monotype Web Page Content entitlement**."* |
| 2026-08-18 | `f9dbc4a` | Re-added on a **different** branch (`origin/feature/f2r-component-registry`) — 1 day after removal. Not on `develop`. |
| **2026-08-20** | **`34486eb`** (author + committer Marcel Navarro) | **Re-added on this branch.** |

## (b)/(c) Reason given for re-adding, and the licence question

`34486eb`'s body gives **only technical/visual justification** — no licence resolution:

> *"The fallback stack renders roughly 13% wider, which is why serving the real faces matters for design-parity review against Figma."*
> *"**Licence files are deliberately excluded from the repository.**"*

That last line is the closest thing to a licence statement, and it addresses only whether the *licence text* is committed — not whether the entitlement exists. Searching the whole repo (`.md`/`.ts`/`.tsx`/`.mdc`) for `entitlement`, `Web Page Content`, `Monotype`, `EULA`, `foundry`: **no evidence found that the Monotype Web Page Content entitlement was ever obtained, requested, or discussed.** The prohibition was reversed, not resolved.

**Fonts are currently committed, tracked, and served in production:**
- `git ls-files` → `overrides/app/static/fonts/FuturaRound-{Medium,Regular}.woff2` (both tracked, 29784/30364 bytes)
- `git check-ignore` → not ignored; `.gitignore` contains **no** font/woff/licence entries
- `overrides/app/components/_app-config/index.tsx:10,158` mounts `<ZimmFontFace />` — that's the **production app shell**, not just Storybook, despite the commit title saying "for development and testing"

## The prohibition text was deleted, and 4 files still contradict the new state

`34486eb` replaced this in `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/.claude/rules/frozenFiles.md` (Tier 1):

```
-**No font binaries in this repo.** Futura Round ships under a Monotype *"Font Software For
-Desktop End User License Agreement"* which forbids "further distribute the Font Software, or
-any copy thereof" and "Install the Font Software on any server or in any digital asset
-management system" — so `.woff2`/`.otf` must not be committed here or served from the MRT CDN.
-Licence: Zimmermann-Handover repo, `02-design/library/assets/Font Futura WOFF2/Licenses/2275/`.
+**Fonts are self-hosted for development and testing.** ...
```

The specific quoted EULA clauses — the only record of *what* was prohibited — no longer exist anywhere in the repo. `.cursor/rules/tier1FrozenFiles.mdc` and `.github/copilot-instructions.md` were re-synced. **These four were not, and still assert the prohibition:**

- `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/theme/foundation/fonts.ts:1` — `// Futura Round is not self-hosted — the Monotype licence forbids it, so the fallback is`
- `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/theme/components/footer.ts:287` — `// the fallback stack renders ~13% wider than Futura Round (unlicensed for web — see`
- `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/.docs/architecture.md:136` — "brand fonts (Futura Round) are **not** self-hosted — a Monotype Desktop EULA forbids serving the files"
- `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/.docs/memory/projectState.md:46` — "Futura Round is **not** self-hosted (Monotype Desktop EULA forbids serving the files)"

Note `fonts.ts:1` is itself **Tier 1** and points at a frozenFiles.md section that no longer says what it claims.

## Raised in review, no reply

CodeRabbit comment **`3824358405`**, PR #59, `2026-08-20T18:38:48Z`, `.claude/rules/frozenFiles.md:36`, **Major**: headline **"Obtain Tier 1 approval before merging."** — flagging all three synced sites. Related: **`3824358414`** (Major) *"Protected Storybook configuration was changed in two files… restore the protected configuration and obtain an approved font-mounting mechanism"* (`.storybook/main.js`, `.storybook/preview.tsx` — both Tier 1). `34486eb`'s body asserts tier-1-approver identity was verified. **Neither finding has an in-thread reply** (see Item 4 addendum). Neither finding challenged the licence itself — so the licence question was not re-raised by review either.

---

# ITEM 3 — Locale label: **fixed for 1 storefront of 11; still wrong for 10**

## (a) `cc9a8f1` (2026-08-21) in full — it is a two-line change

```diff
+const LOCALE_LABEL_PLACEHOLDER = 'Australia (AUD) / ENG';
...
-          <chakra.span __css={styles.localeText}>United States (USD) / ENG</chakra.span>
+          <chakra.span __css={styles.localeText}>{LOCALE_LABEL_PLACEHOLDER}</chakra.span>
```

One hardcoded literal was replaced with another. The commit message admits this outright: *"Hardcoded… Set to match the site the app actually serves at '/'… **The real fix reads site.l10n.defaultLocale and the site's currency via useMultiSite when the locale selector lands**, at which point this constant goes away."*

## (b)/(c) Current state — `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/footer/index.tsx:364-376`

```tsx
        <chakra.button
          type="button"
          aria-label="Change locale"
          __css={styles.localeButton}
          // PLACEHOLDER: wire to locale selector once available.
          // Label and destination are hardcoded until sourced from active locale/site config.
          onClick={undefined}
        >
          <chakra.span __css={styles.localeText}>{LOCALE_LABEL_PLACEHOLDER}</chakra.span>
```

Rendered unconditionally by `BottomBar`; no site/locale input. `useMultiSite` **is imported** (line 13) but is not used for the label.

## Site count: there are **11** PWA storefronts, not 8

`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/config/sites.overlay.js:29-49` — 11 PWA site entries backed by 8 SFCC sites (EU domestic splits into 4 single-locale PWA sites). `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/.docs/prd/regional.md:19-31` lists the same 11 rows with currencies:

| Storefront | Currency (regional.md) | `'Australia (AUD) / ENG'` correct? |
|---|---|---|
| AU `/` | AUD | ✅ |
| UK `/uk/` | GBP | ❌ |
| US dom `/us/` | USD | ❌ |
| US intl `/en-ca/` | USD | ❌ |
| EU dom EN/FR/IT/ES | EUR ×4 | ❌ ×4 (and FR/IT/ES also wrong on language) |
| EU intl `/en-ch/` | EUR | ❌ |
| HK `/hk/` | HKD | ❌ |
| ME `/en-ae/` | AED | ❌ |

**Fixed for 1 of 11. Still wrong for 10.**

## Two further problems the fix did not touch

1. **The dead-button half of the same finding was dropped.** CodeRabbit comment **`3824358452`**, `2026-08-20T18:38:48Z`, `footer/index.tsx:376` raised *both* halves:
   > *"`onClick={undefined}` leaves a focusable `<button>` with `aria-label="Change locale"`. Keyboard and screen-reader users reach it, activate it, and nothing happens. The label text `'United States (USD) / ENG'` is also hardcoded… **Until the locale selector lands, set `disabled` (or `aria-disabled` plus `tabIndex={-1}`)** so the control does not promise an action, **and** move the label text into a named constant."*

   `cc9a8f1` did the named-constant half only. Line 370 still reads `onClick={undefined}` with no `disabled`/`aria-disabled`/`tabIndex`. **Elapsed: raised 2026-08-20 18:38, half-fixed 2026-08-21, other half open at HEAD.**

2. **Per the PRD, this control should not be on AU at all.** `.docs/prd/regional.md:65` — *"**Country + language selector** available on all storefronts **except AU** (REG-020, REG-025)."* The one storefront whose label is now correct is the one storefront that shouldn't render the control.

**Side finding (config vs PRD drift, out of scope but worth a ticket):** `config/sites.generated.js` gives `ZimmermannHK.defaultCurrency = 'USD'` and `ZimmermannME.defaultCurrency = 'EUR'`, while `regional.md:30-31` says HKD and AED. So even the "real fix" reading `site.l10n` would produce PRD-inconsistent labels for HK and ME today.

# Addendum — the mechanism behind all three "dropped" items
